title: Protocols & Standards
markdown:
### Protocols

A **protocol** is synonymous with *rule*. Protocols define the rules that govern data communications between devices.

### Standards

**Standards** are agreed-upon rules that ensure devices from different manufacturers can communicate. Standards fall into two categories:

- **De facto** ("by fact") — Standards adopted through widespread use rather than formal approval (e.g. the original TCP/IP suite).
- **De jure** ("by law") — Standards established by an officially recognized body (e.g. IEEE 802.11 for Wi-Fi).

### Key Standards Organizations

- **ISO** — International Organization for Standardization
- **IEEE** — Institute of Electrical and Electronics Engineers
- **ITU-T** — International Telecommunication Union
- **ANSI** — American National Standards Institute
- **IETF** — Internet Engineering Task Force (publishes RFCs)
